title: Optimistic WS Gateway launch, engine fixes, and UI performance sprint
highlights: Shipped optimistic WS-first gateway with per-viewer state masking, HTTP action ingress, and prod deploy script
Multi-PR UI CPU sprint: memoized signing client, split GameStateContext into 5 slices, memoized player components
Fixed SNG heads-up lock-up (DEAL floor was minPlayers entry count instead of 2)
features: Gateway per-viewer state masking: deck always hidden, hole cards visible to owner only
Gateway HTTP POST /actions ingress — request/response submission, broadcasts stay on WS
Gateway deploy script: SSH + compose + nginx WSS location for pvm.block52.xyz
Real PVM-backed Texas Hold'em playable end-to-end through WS gateway
Go WS action gateway spike: in-memory vs Redis state store + stress test
UI GatewayApi client + action signing for optimistic WS gateway (additive, no behavior change)
Force-close cash table: creator kicks and refunds all seated players
bugFixes: SNG heads-up lock-up: DEAL floor corrected to 2 (heads-up), not minPlayers entry count
Allow short all-in shove when already facing a bet
Sparse checkout missing pvm/go/gateway path — deploy now materializes gateway correctly
Hide top-up chips button in SNG games where it should not appear
improvements: Memoize getSigningClient as promise-keyed singleton — eliminates per-action PBKDF2 stall + RPC handshake
Per-seat usePlayerChipData + memoized PlayerChipDisplay leaf — stops 9x render fan-out
Split GameStateContext into five slice contexts to prevent full-tree re-renders
Kill redundant polling; memoize providers and hook return values
Delete dead useCosmosGameState REST poller — no consumers
Docs: optimistic WS-first action flow architecture — chain removed from hot path
Docs: production gateway deployment record with smoke-test numbers
tests: Repair phh-dataset runner — restore stripped console.log calls so test output is readable

title: Pokerchain v0.1.74
highlights: This release fixes SNG game creation to properly emit nextSmallBlind and nextBigBlind fields, and adds automated SSH deployment of the linux-amd64 binary to node1.block52.xyz.
bugFixes: poker: emit nextSmallBlind/nextBigBlind on SNG game creation (#183, #184)
improvements: ci(release): SSH-deploy linux-amd64 binary to node1.block52.xyz

title: Poker VM v1.0.14
features: pvm: Persist SNG blind level start time across roundtrips so the level countdown stays accurate after reconnects
bugFixes: pvm: Preserve SNG/Tournament blind fields (smallBlind, bigBlind, ante, next-blind escalation) on GameOptionsDTO so they aren't dropped at the DTO boundary
pvm: Allow leaving an SNG/tournament when there are insufficient players to continue; rely on blind/ante checks rather than a strict currentRound gate
pvm: RPC error responses now include the original error message for easier debugging
improvements: pvm: Move next-blind escalation logic into IBlindsManager for a single source of truth on level transitions
tests: pvm: Regression coverage for the river raise-then-call scenario — roundEndDetectionManager unit test plus an integration test that replays the exact state from the issue and verifies performAction(FOLD) and performAction(CALL) both succeed
